value: Which of the following are characteristic of non-market economies?
answers: the use of money as a means of exchange
the ability to accumulate vast amounts of capital
highly complex economic interactions that are ultimately international in their scale

value: Which of the following statements is true concerning non-market economies?
answers: They are typically found in small-scale, isolated societies.
There usually is a high level of technological knowledge.
Large-scale collaboration on subsistence jobs is common.
correct_answer: They are typically found in small-scale, isolated societies.

value: If, after several minutes of negotiation, you agree to trade three music CD's with a friend for his used copy of the textbook needed in your cultural anthropology class, it would be an example of ____ .
Formal market places are rare in isolated, small-scale societies because ____ .
answers: the advantages of trading in them are slight since every household usually provides for its daily needs from its own production.
surpluses cannot be easily sent to areas of scarcity due to limited transportation capabilities
effective food preservation technology is usually not available so perishable items do not last long

value: Which of the following statements is true of non-market economies?
answers: They can only survive in isolation from the market economies of large-scale societies.
Most small-scale societies today still have thriving non-market economies.
Large-scale societies are beginning to give up their market economies in favor of non-market ones.
correct_answer: They can only survive in isolation from the market economies of large-scale societies.

value: Proprietary deed has been strongly supported by ____ ?
answers: the U.S. and Canadian national cultures, which are European in origin
most Native American cultures in the 19th century and earlier
correct_answer: the U.S. and Canadian national cultures, which are European in origin

value: Which of the following would fit the definition of negative reciprocity in North America today?
answers: selling flashlight batteries at triple the normal price during a prolonged blackout caused by a widespread electrical power failure
buying lunch at an inexpensive fast food restaurant and paying for it with money
correct_answer: selling flashlight batteries at triple the normal price during a prolonged blackout caused by a widespread electrical power failure

value: Which of the following were intended functions of the Kwakiutl potlatch ceremonies in the 19th century?
answers: to celebrate major life events in a family
to dispose of worthless surplus property that could not be bartered or sold to others
to reinforce the fact that no one had the right to special economic and ceremonial privileges
correct_answer: to celebrate major life events in a family

value: Which of the following things resulted from international commerce during the last two centuries?
answers: There has been an enormous redistribution of wealth to the industrialized nations located mostly in the Northern Hemisphere
There has been a redistribution of wealth from the rich nations to the poor ones so that the economic disparity between them is now less than it was two centuries ago.
There is now a balance in trade between the richest and the poorest nations in the world.
correct_answer: There has been an enormous redistribution of wealth to the industrialized nations located mostly in the Northern Hemisphere

value: Age-based categories are referred to by anthropologists as ____ .
Which of the following statements is true?
answers: It is common for people to have multiple overlapping statuses and roles.
Social group membership usually gives us a set of statuses and role tags that make it more difficult for people to know what to expect from each other.
correct_answer: It is common for people to have multiple overlapping statuses and roles.
